title: basic-auth job search: POST /jobs/search returns only the caller's own jobs, creator-less jobs are hidden from non-admins
answers: Under basic-auth, a non-admin user can see other users' job ids, params and result/error text from the job search listing; how is that scoped?
Why does a job I submitted not show up in the native jobs search for another user, or why is a legacy job with no creator missing from search?
Where is the job search response filtered by owner, and how does the admin listing stay unfiltered?
Adding a new field to the FastAPI job response model: does it need to be carried for the auth layer to see ownership?
body:
Path: Native FastAPI job listing `POST /ajax-api/3.0/jobs/search` on the basic-auth app, which returns every job in the store (unpaginated). Per-id get and cancel routes are handled separately by `_get_job_route_validator`. The search response passes through `mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_filter_search_jobs`.
Rule: `_filter_search_jobs` keeps only jobs whose `creator` equals the caller's username, and drops jobs with a missing creator (fail closed, same as the per-id ownership check). It is registered in `FASTAPI_ENDPOINT_RESPONSE_FILTERS` keyed on `mlflow/server/job_api.py:search_jobs`. The `creator` field on the `mlflow/server/job_api.py:Job` response model is what the filter reads, so any change that drops it from the response silently hides every job from non-admins.
Symptom: Under `--app-name basic-auth`, any authenticated non-admin could call the job search and enumerate every other user's jobs, including params and results, while get-by-id already returned 403 for the same job (GHSA-9pch-m9gq-c25q).
Constraints: Applies to non-admins only; admins skip response filters and keep the full listing including creator-less rows. Jobs with no recorded creator (rows predating the creator column, worker-spawned online-scoring child jobs) are invisible to non-admins in search. Filtering is post-response and is only correct because the search handler returns the full result set without pagination. Covered by `tests/server/auth/test_auth.py:test_job_search_only_returns_callers_jobs`.
applies: Basic-auth FastAPI job search (`/ajax-api/3.0/jobs/search`), the `Job` response model, and any new job listing route that must be owner-scoped.
says: Non-admin users can see all submitted jobs, parameters, and error logs across accounts.
The jobs list should only display runs created by the currently logged-in account.
Legacy jobs without a recorded author are missing from the search jobs screen.
Prevent regular members from viewing job results and parameters launched by other users.
search: In basic-auth FastAPI, POST /ajax-api/3.0/jobs/search runs _filter_search_jobs registered in FASTAPI_ENDPOINT_RESPONSE_FILTERS on mlflow/server/job_api.py:search_jobs to return only unpaginated jobs where creator matches the caller's username. Jobs missing a creator on the Job response model are dropped for non-admins, while admin callers bypass response filtering and retain creator-less rows. Per-ID retrieval and cancellation routes are handled separately by _get_job_route_validator. Applies to --app-name basic-auth job search and is verified by tests/server/auth/test_auth.py:test_job_search_only_returns_callers_jobs.
